Your holdings: SOXL (-44.37%) and SPAL (-39.44%) are deep in the red and leveraged, meaning drawdowns hurt extra on margin. SMH (-8.16%) is also down. These need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for its impact on growth stocks, and how the chip sector reacts to the SanDisk news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged positions while selectively looking for opportunities in core chip names.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL stops immediately; their deep losses and leveraged nature demand tight risk management.
